science.intro: We don't rely on marketing claims. The nutritional power of our 100% plant-based ingredients is documented by global health authorities and decades of clinical trials. Don't just take our word for it—read the research.

items.q: 🫀 What the Research Says About Soy & Heart Health
items.a:
A comprehensive meta-analysis of 46 clinical trials reported that soy protein lowered total and LDL ("bad") cholesterol. The authors note this supports the long-standing reference intake of 25g of soy protein a day as part of a diet low in saturated fat. Because a plant-based drink naturally displaces saturated fat, it's an easy way to work soy into your day.

Read the research by Blanco Mejia et al. ↗

Unlike most plant proteins, soybean is recognised by nutrition scientists as a complete protein. Studies evaluating protein quality report that soy protein isolate achieves a Protein Digestibility-Corrected Amino Acid Score (PDCAAS) of 1.00 — matching the value of animal proteins like milk and whey, without the cholesterol or lactose.

Read the research by Hughes et al. ↗

items.q: 🛡️ What the Research Says About Soy Safety
items.a:
A comprehensive safety evaluation of soy isoflavones reviewed their effects in humans and concluded they are safe to consume, reporting no harmful effects on breast tissue, the uterus, or the thyroid hormone system in healthy women. It's the reassurance behind whole-soybean nutrition.

Read the safety evaluation by Hüser et al. ↗

A review of the clinical and epidemiological literature highlights that whole soybeans are a rare, rich plant source of polyunsaturated fats along with naturally occurring plant compounds (isoflavones). The author summarises how whole-soy nutrition has been studied in relation to lipid metabolism and overall health.

Read the epidemiological literature by Messina ↗

chatKnowledge.a: Nutrition science is clear that protein is the most satiating macronutrient — it keeps you full and helps preserve lean muscle while you lose fat. Soya Protein X gives 17.91 g complete protein per 300 ml with no added sugar and fibre from flax & chia (~181 kcal) — a filling swap for a sugary snack. General nutrition info, not medical advice.

For muscle you need enough complete protein and the essential amino acids that trigger repair. Soy is a rare complete plant protein with all 9 essential amino acids plus built-in BCAAs (leucine). A 500 ml Protein X delivers 29.85 g protein in easy-to-drink form — handy around workouts.

Most plant proteins miss an essential amino acid — soy is the exception, providing all 9 essential amino acids at a quality (PDCAAS ≈ 0.9–1.0) comparable to milk and egg. That's why our whole-soybean Protein X counts as a complete protein.

This is the biggest soy myth. Soy isoflavones are phytoestrogens — plant compounds that behave very differently from human estrogen. Large research reviews find moderate soy does not lower testosterone or raise estrogen in men. It's safe and nourishing for everyone. If you have a hormone-sensitive condition, check with your doctor.

Plant foods have zero cholesterol — both our drinks are cholesterol-free and low in saturated fat. Soy protein has been studied for heart health, and the omega-3 (ALA) from our flax & chia adds to a heart-friendly profile. Not a treatment for any condition.
Omega-3 and 6 are essential fats your body can't make. Protein X is infused with flax and chia, giving ~1.6 g plant omega-3 (ALA) per 300 ml — a far more balanced ratio than typical processed foods.

Perfect fit — an estimated 60–70% of Indian adults are lactose-intolerant. Both drinks are 100% plant-based with zero lactose and zero dairy, so you get protein and refreshment without the discomfort.

Both drinks have no added sugar — only the little that occurs naturally. Protein and fibre slow how fast sugars enter the blood, so a protein-forward, low-added-sugar drink is generally gentler than a sweetened one. If you manage diabetes, follow your doctor's/dietitian's guidance.

Our Boondi Masala Chaas is curd-cultured — fermented soy, the traditional step behind classic chaas. Cultured drinks plus fibre support a healthy gut, and being dairy-free it's gentle on lactose-sensitive stomachs.
100% plant-based by design — no dairy, no animal input, cruelty-free. Soy is the go-to for vegans and vegetarians because it's a complete protein, solving the biggest gap in plant diets.

Flaxseed is one of the richest plant sources of omega-3 (ALA), fibre and lignans; chia adds omega-3, fibre and a little protein. We infuse both into Protein X for a heart- and digestion-friendly boost you can drink.
Many protein drinks use stripped isolates. We build on whole soybean, keeping more of the natural fibre, minerals and healthy fats — nutrition the way nature packaged it, never fillers.
Food adulteration — especially milk — is a serious problem in India, and it's core to why we exist: pure, daily-fresh plant nourishment with the honesty of a home kitchen and lab-tested nutrition.

A common guideline (WHO/ICMR) is ~0.8–1 g protein per kg body weight daily — roughly 50–70 g for many adults, more if active. Most Indian diets fall short; a 500 ml Protein X gives 29.85 g in one drink.

_comment_faq: Grouped by theme (freshness → taste → nutrition → ingredients/trust → ordering) with emoji cues for scannability. Keep answers concise and FSSAI-safe: no disease/cure claims; point soy-safety questions to the Science section.

faq.q: 🧊 How long does it stay fresh? (shelf life)
faq.a: Shelf life is 3 days, chilled. With zero preservatives the fridge does all the work — it lasts longest kept cold from our hands to your glass.

faq.q: 🫙 Why does it settle — do I shake it?
faq.a: Give it a shake. Natural settling just means there are no artificial stabilisers holding it together.

faq.q: ❄️ Can I freeze it to make it last longer?
faq.a: Better not — freezing splits the texture. Keep it chilled, not frozen, and enjoy within 3 days.

faq.q: 🥤 Chaas or Protein X — what's the difference?
faq.a: Chaas is a light, cultured, masala refresher. Protein X packs up to 29.85 g protein a bottle. Both are 100% plant-based, dairy-free and cholesterol-free.

faq.q: 😋 Does the Chaas actually taste like chaas?
faq.a: It does — cultured soy curd, roasted spices and mustard oil, the desi way. Familiar taste, plant-based body.

faq.q: 💪 How much protein do I really get?
faq.a: 300 ml gives 17.91 g protein, 500 ml gives 29.85 g (about 54% of an adult's daily protein) — both with all 9 essential amino acids.
100% plant-based by design — no dairy, no lactose, no cholesterol, nothing from an animal.
Completely. It's built for dairy-sensitive and lactose-intolerant folks — zero of either.

faq.q: 🍬 How much sugar is in it?
faq.a: No added sugar. The trace that's there occurs naturally — no spike, no crash.
A natural fit — complete protein plus built-in BCAAs, already in easy-to-drink liquid form.

faq.q: 🧬 Is soy safe to drink regularly?
faq.a: Soy is one of the few complete plant proteins and has been studied for decades. See our "Backed by Global Science" section for the actual research.
Whole soybean, plus flax & chia in Protein X, and roasted spices & mustard oil in the Chaas. Whole ingredients — never stripped isolates or fillers.
Every figure comes from our Fast Labs test report — measured in a lab, not marketing guesswork.

faq.q: 📍 Do you deliver to my area?
faq.a: We currently deliver only within {{serviceAreas}}. Open the cart, enter your pincode (or tap "Use my current location"), and it'll tell you instantly — or join the waitlist if we're not there yet.

Pick a plan: Single Bottle (one-time trial), Weekly (7 days), 15-Day, or Monthly (30 days) — plus how many bottles per day. The full amount is charged once, upfront, via secure Razorpay checkout, then we deliver fresh daily for the length of your plan. You'll get a personal tracking link showing every delivery's status.

faq.q: ⏸️ Can I pause or change my plan?
faq.a: Yes — message us on WhatsApp with your order details anytime to pause, skip, or cancel remaining undelivered days. Days already delivered aren't refundable since they're made fresh specifically for you; undelivered days are refunded pro-rata. Full details in our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

Payment is entirely through Razorpay's secure checkout — cards, UPI (GPay/PhonePe/any app), netbanking, and wallets are all supported in one locked, server-priced window. WhatsApp is there for questions, not payment.

faq.q: 📦 What if something's wrong with my order?
faq.a: Message us on WhatsApp within 4 hours of delivery with a photo — damaged, spoiled, or wrong item, and we'll replace it free on your next delivery or refund that bottle. Being fresh and short-life, we can't accept claims reported later than that.
